clauses.body: The supplier shall supply the goods described in the schedule in the quantities ordered, and shall deliver them to the address stated on each order within the agreed lead time.
clauses.heading: Supply

clauses.body: Prices are those set out in the schedule and hold for twelve months from the date of this agreement. Invoices are payable within thirty days of the invoice date.
clauses.heading: Price and payment

clauses.body: The goods shall conform to their specification and be free from defects in materials and workmanship for twelve months from delivery.
clauses.heading: Quality

clauses.body: Either party may end this agreement by giving three months written notice, without affecting any order already accepted.
clauses.heading: Termination
